data.narrative:
Thunder Tiger is a public-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $22M+ as of 2025 and is led by founder Chun Lin Lai (Aling Lai). The valuation analysis draws on a Defense & Security comp universe of 21 same-sector peers, comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, Evolv Technology, and Saronic.

The peer-median approach is not applicable here due to insufficient narrow peer clustering. While 21 Defense & Security companies exist in the dataset, filtering by stage, adjacency, and valuation tier yielded fewer than three comparable datapoints—the minimum threshold for reliable triangulation. Applying an all-sector median would introduce unacceptable sectoral bias given the capital intensity and regulatory specificity of defense businesses.

The narrow comp set and public-stage transition create material valuation uncertainty. A rigorous valuation conclusion cannot be supported without either: (1) expansion of the private peer set through deeper market research, (2) application of discounted cash flow or comparable transaction multiples with explicit modeling of capital intensity and government contract concentration, or (3) acceptance of wide confidence intervals around published public comparables. The analyst recommends deferred valuation pending improved data quality or disclosure of Thunder Tiger's revenue and profitability metrics.
